_comment: LADDER RUN, to be launched only after the gate config has shown the head can learn at all. Two axes crossed, four runs. num_custom_layers separates 'FedAvg averages a hidden layer whose units nobody aligned' from everything else: with one Linear there is no hidden layer and no permutation freedom. dirichlet_alpha separates 'the label skew is what breaks it' - which is what unsynchronised BatchNorm statistics predict, since they only drift apart when the clients see different classes - from a failure that happens even on near-IID data. alpha 100 is the near-uniform control, alpha 0.5 reproduces the failing cell. Same separate base paths as the gate config.
